boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct, source-documented study environments within Schaffer Library, from silent reading rooms to small-group and media-equipped spaces.

cards.title: Lally Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Schaffer Library, first floor
cards.notes: Set up behind the first-floor glass doors when you need a no-conversation, no-cellphone-use reading session.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet-study room with strict sound rules.
cards.evidence_claim: Schaffer designates the Lally Reading Room, behind glass doors on the first floor, as a Quiet Study area where conversations and cellphone use are prohibited.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces | Schaffer Library | Union College
cards.access_notes: Schaffer Library entrance requires a Union ID; follow the Quiet Study rules posted for this room.

cards.entity_name: Schaffer Library Third Floor Quiet Study
cards.title: Third Floor Quiet Study
cards.subtitle: Schaffer Library, third floor
cards.notes: Bring reading or solo work upstairs and keep phones silent; this entire floor is designated for quiet study.
cards.short_summary: A whole-floor quiet zone for focused individual work.
cards.evidence_claim: Schaffer Library identifies its entire third floor as a Quiet Study zone with no conversations or cellphone use.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces | Schaffer Library | Union College
cards.access_notes: Schaffer Library entrance requires a Union ID; no conversation or cellphone use is permitted in Quiet Study zones.

cards.title: Second Floor Stacks Quiet Study
cards.subtitle: Schaffer Library, second floor behind glass doors
cards.notes: Use the stacks behind the glass doors for reading that benefits from silence and a nearby circulating-book collection.
cards.short_summary: Quiet seating beside the second-floor book stacks.
cards.evidence_claim: Schaffer designates the second-floor stacks behind the glass doors as Quiet Study, and its floor directory places circulating books on the second floor.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces | Schaffer Library | Union College
cards.access_notes: Schaffer Library entrance requires a Union ID; Quiet Study permits neither conversations nor cellphone use.

cards.title: Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Schaffer Library, first floor
cards.notes: Choose this first-floor area for a project that benefits from research workstations and conversation-permitted collaboration.
cards.short_summary: The library’s open-collaboration area with research workstations.
cards.evidence_claim: Union describes the first-floor Learning Commons as student-focused support for independent and collaborative research; Schaffer designates it an Open Collaboration zone.
cards.access_notes: Schaffer Library entrance requires a Union ID; conversation is permitted in the first-floor Open Collaboration zone.

cards.title: Café-Styled Booths
cards.subtitle: Schaffer Library, first and second floors
cards.notes: Meet a partner at one of the library’s booths on the first or second floor and keep the conversation appropriate to the zone.
cards.short_summary: Built-in booth seating on two library floors.
cards.evidence_claim: Schaffer Library lists café-styled booths as available on its first and second floors.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces | Schaffer Library | Union College
cards.access_notes: Schaffer Library entrance requires a Union ID; the second floor is quiet collaboration except behind its glass doors.

cards.title: Group Study Room 14
cards.subtitle: Schaffer Library, basement
cards.notes: Use this basement room for a private small-group session; plan for first-come, first-served use rather than a reservation.
cards.evidence_claim: Schaffer identifies Group Study Room 14 in the basement, and its building policy says basement study rooms are first-come, first-served.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces | Schaffer Library | Union College
cards.access_notes: Schaffer Library entrance requires a Union ID; basement study rooms are first-come, first-served.

cards.title: Group Study Room 15
cards.subtitle: Schaffer Library, basement
cards.notes: Bring a small team to this basement room for focused discussion, leaving the doorway clear for fire-safety compliance.
cards.short_summary: A separate basement room for private group work.
cards.evidence_claim: Schaffer identifies Group Study Room 15 in the basement; its building policy requires that study-room doors not be blocked.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces | Schaffer Library | Union College
cards.access_notes: Schaffer Library entrance requires a Union ID; basement study rooms are first-come, first-served and doorways must remain clear.

cards.title: Group Study Room 210
cards.subtitle: Schaffer Library, second floor
cards.notes: Use Room 210 for a private gathering; students needing media equipment receive priority in the library’s group-study rooms.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor private study room with media-use priority.
cards.evidence_claim: Schaffer lists Group Study Room 210 on the second floor and states that students requiring media equipment have priority in group-study rooms.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces | Schaffer Library | Union College
cards.access_notes: Schaffer Library entrance requires a Union ID; check room availability and yield priority to students who require media equipment.

cards.title: Learning Lab, Room 232
cards.subtitle: Schaffer Library, second floor
cards.notes: Use the modular tables and chairs for group work when no scheduled library instruction session is using Room 232.
cards.short_summary: A flexible, reconfigured room for collaborative study.
cards.evidence_claim: Union reports that Learning Lab Room 232 has modular furniture for group collaboration and is available for student group study when library instruction is not scheduled.
cards.source_title: Learning Lab gets revamped | Schaffer Library | Union College
cards.access_notes: Schaffer Library entrance requires a Union ID; scheduled library instruction classes take priority over group study.

cards.title: Viewing Stations
cards.subtitle: Schaffer Library, first floor
cards.notes: Work through a course film or DVD at a first-floor station; ask the Service Desk about Roku sticks or external disc drives.
cards.short_summary: Two first-floor media stations with TVs and DVD-capable computers.
cards.evidence_claim: Schaffer Library provides two first-floor viewing stations with TVs, Roku-stick compatibility, and computers with DVD drives for the library DVD collection.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces | Schaffer Library | Union College
cards.access_notes: Schaffer Library entrance requires a Union ID; Roku sticks and external disc drives are available for checkout at the Library Service Desk.
